PR title:
Prevent multiline error message on invalid path

PR body:
Fixes an issue where an invalid `click.Path` parameter, which contains a `\n`, will result in an error that prints out on multiple lines.

fixes #2697


Gold patch (use only to infer the symptom; do not quote or describe the fix):

--- a/CHANGES.rst
+++ b/CHANGES.rst
@@ -6,6 +6,9 @@ Version 8.1.8
 Unreleased
 
 -   Fix an issue with type hints for ``click.open_file()``. :issue:`2717`
+-   Fix issue where error message for invalid ``click.Path`` displays on
+    multiple lines. :issue:`2697`
+
 
 Version 8.1.7

message.content: When a `click.Path` parameter receives an invalid path containing a newline character, the error message is displayed across multiple lines instead of as a single line.
